connectors.name: AnimeUnity
connectors.releaseNotes: 0.1.2: fix native-validation rejection — streams final extract fields are strict (model keys only); the variant marker moved from a custom 'filemark' field onto qualityLabel (free-form model field) via the same SUB_ITA->SUB / ITA->DUB transform chain, and the where filter now tests qualityLabel. Gating semantics unchanged: wrong-variant requests yield no candidate, never a substitution.
